meanings: IF_ICMPLT: jump if the first int is less than the second
IF_ICMPLE: jump if the first int is less than or equal to the second
applied.note: javac compiles `total >= 100` to IF_ICMPLT, a jump past the body when `total < 100`: the opposite of the source. With IF_ICMPLE it jumps when `total <= 100`, so the body runs only when `total > 100`

operator.description: `<` becomes `<=` and the other way round: the off-by-one at the edge of a range, which tests that only check values far from the edge never notice.

idDescription: m855c8e3c: `m` and the first 8 hex digits of its fingerprint, 855c8e3ca8a39847, a SHA-256 of the class, method, site and change
idNote: no line number goes in, so the id stays the same when code above it moves

site.description: instruction site 1 of discount(I)I, counting from 1 (arithmetic, branches and returns are counted in bytecode order; calls apart)

lastRun.description: missed: every covering test still passed
